title: fix(agent-loop): skip empty assistant turn when replaying history to Anthropic

files.patch:
@@ -238,6 +238,11 @@ def _format_messages(self, messages: list[Message]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
         previous_was_tool = False
         for msg in messages:
             entry = self._format_message(msg)
+            if entry["role"] == "assistant" and entry["content"] == [{"type": "text", "text": ""}]:
+                # An empty reply (no text, no tool calls) has nothing to replay;
+                # Anthropic rejects an empty text block with a 400.
+                logger.debug("anthropic: skipped an empty assistant turn")
+                continue
             is_tool = msg.role == MessageRole.TOOL
             if is_tool and previous_was_tool:
                 formatted[-1]["content"].extend(entry["content"])

@@ -703,3 +703,17 @@ async def test_error_during_text_iteration_is_wrapped(self) -> None:
         with pytest.raises(TransportError):
             async for _ in transport.stream([UserMessage(content="hi")]):
                 pass
+
+
+class TestEmptyAssistantTurn:
+    def test_format_messages_skips_empty_assistant_turn(self) -> None:
+        transport = _transport()
+        formatted = transport._format_messages(
+            [
+                UserMessage(content="hi"),
+                AssistantMessage(content=[]),
+                UserMessage(content="Your last reply came through empty"),
+            ]
+        )
+        assert [m["role"] for m in formatted] == ["user", "user"]
+        assert all({"type": "text", "text": ""} not in m["content"] for m in formatted if isinstance(m["content"], list))
